title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.32971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist.

translated_title: RobustRLlib：鲁棒强化学习算法的统一库与基准测试
translated_abstract: 鲁棒强化学习（RL）对于可靠的真实世界部署至关重要，因为策略可能在多种偏移和扰动下失效。现有的鲁棒RL算法提供了丰富的机制和原理，但两大障碍限制了其更广泛的应用潜力：算法可复用性有限，以及实证能力边界不清晰。我们提出了RobustRLlib，一个以算法为中心的库和基准测试平台，以应对这两个挑战。它集成了17种代表性的鲁棒在线、离线和安全RL算法，并采用统一接口以显著提升可复用性，同时提供了一个增强的评估平台，涵盖多样化的真实世界偏移以及先进的人形机器人和视觉-语言-动作任务。通过对273种扰动配置的系统评估，本工作提供了当前鲁棒RL算法的最新能力图谱，揭示了这些算法在哪些场景下仍然有效，以及在哪些方面仍存在显著的鲁棒性差距。
tldr: 本文提出RobustRLlib，一个集成了17种鲁棒在线、离线与安全RL算法的统一库与基准测试平台，并通过273种扰动配置的系统评估绘制了当前鲁棒RL算法的能力图谱，揭示了其有效范围与鲁棒性差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RobustRLlib, a unified library and benchmark integrating 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms, and provides an up-to-date capability map of robust RL through systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations.
